title: The share rule and the fixed rule on net1 v4: test links, once, with copies
description: The single test of net2 on net1 v4. Validation (exp-net2v4-val-16, exp-share-copies-val-17) left a trade-off rather than a winner: the share rule (u = 0.125 + k busy max(0, 1 - receive/capacity)) gains against a Cubic flow from the start and loses against copies of itself, at every k. So three candidates fixed in advance run here, none chosen on test: the fixed rule on net1 v4 (u = 0.125), the share rule at k = 0.5 and at k = 1, with the true-BDP rule (u = 0.375) and all 17 kernel controllers, on the 27 test links: the five validation families (seeds 13 and 31), BBRv3 or Westwood from 0 s (test only), and 2 and 4 copies of each candidate, BBRv3, Cubic and BBRv1 for 30 s (experiments/copies.py, seed 31). Steps keep labels and actions only.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; M="$IN/models"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$M/net1v3.pt" --u 0.375 --oracle; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 0.5 1; C=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.onnx"); P=("${C[@]}" --policy "oracle-u0.375=$OUT/oracle/rule-u0.375-oracle.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 all "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock all "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3,cubic,bbr "${C[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT"
